title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
lineage: Recording from front row, 15' from stage, mic attached to top of lean-to tent

ai_review.summary: High‑energy performance highlighted by an epic Wharf Rat jam and fiery Tennessee Jed, captured from an unknown source quality.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the soaring jam into Wharf Rat – dubbed “Franklin’s fire” – and a scorching rendition of Tennessee Jed.  Even a rainstorm couldn’t dampen the vibe; the keyboardist kept things rolling and a spontaneous nod with Jerry added to the magic.  No concrete details on the recording fidelity were offered, but the musical excitement shines through.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive about the performance (5, 4, 5 stars) while offering little on recording quality; weighted estimate favors the excellent show with an assumed average technical capture.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on sound clarity, mix balance, or source type, leaving recording fidelity uncertain.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as ‘on fire’, maintaining high energy despite rain; the keyboardist’s steady playing kept momentum, and a spontaneous nod with Jerry highlighted the concert’s intimacy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewer exchanged a nod with Jerry, indicating a memorable personal moment but no specific performance comment.
band_member_comments.Bob: A nod exchange with Bobby was noted by a fan.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboardist kept the vibe alive during rain by playing straight through it.
